summary: Regression retest after fixes for (1) 422 on athlete save with empty numeric fields and (2) AI recommend hitting LLM budget. Direct curl confirms PUT /api/athlete/me now accepts age/height/weight='' (returns 200, coerced to None via field_validator). AI prompts trimmed to top-5 candidates + short pt-BR format — produces compact responses well under the per-call LLM budget.
